title: refactor: separate image support from input limits
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Uses input modalities to decide whether Play accepts images
- Treats a missing reference-image limit as unknown instead of unsupported
- Removes guessed text-model limits while retaining documented provider limits

Checks:
- `npm exec -- biome check apps/playground/src/Playground.tsx packages/ui/src/compositions/FileUpload.tsx shared/registry/text.ts`
- `npm run typecheck --prefix packages/ui`
- `npm run typecheck --prefix apps/playground`
- `npm run build:app --prefix apps/playground`

gist.headline: Images Ask the Right Question
gist.blurb: Play now checks a model’s actual input modalities before deciding whether to welcome an image. The hive has stopped mistaking an unknown signpost for a locked gate.
gist.summary: Playground image uploads now use each model’s declared input modalities, treat missing reference-image limits as unknown rather than unsupported, and retain only documented provider text limits.
gist.impact: Users can attach images to models that declare image input support without being blocked by guessed limits, while documented provider limits continue to guide uploads.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy playground terminal acts as a garden gate with separate text and image paths: Polli reads clear modality signs while gently guiding a pixel image card through the image-enabled path. A small code-plant and friendly CRT monitor show that unknown limits are a question mark, not a closed door.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow bee mascot with dark brown stripes, black oval eyes, pink rectangular blush, light blue wings, and a tiny librarian scarf, reading a retro terminal’s modality sign while guiding a pixel photo card through an open garden gate labeled "IMAGE OK"; a friendly CRT robot holds a small question-mark limit card beside blooming code-plants. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, dark purple (#110518) outlines, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, nostalgic but beautiful.
